title: PRD: In-App Messaging & Trade Chat — xCube
problem_statement: xCube retail investors discuss trades and market setups on external platforms (Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram) and then context-switch back to the app to execute. This 6–8 minute execution gap reduces trade conversion and increases abandonment to competitor apps. There is no way to share a live ticker directly into a conversation or act on a peer's trade idea without leaving xCube. Users who receive a timely in-context prompt are 2.8× more likely to execute a trade on the same platform.

personas.name: Alex — Active Self-Directed Trader
personas.description: Trades 10–20 times per month, follows 3–5 stock communities on Discord
personas.goal: Discuss live setups and share positions with peers without leaving the trading app
personas.pain: Misses execution windows while copying ticker symbols between Discord and the order screen

personas.name: Jamie — Casual Community Investor
personas.description: Buys and holds, follows finance influencers; checks portfolio weekly
personas.goal: Learn from more experienced traders in real time to build confidence
personas.pain: No way to ask questions about a position from within xCube; must go to Reddit or Discord

user_journeys.name: Join a topic channel and discuss a ticker
steps: User opens the Chat tab in the bottom nav
User taps to join a channel and sees the live message thread
User reads an AAPL setup message with an embedded ticker card showing $227.52 (+1.83%)
User taps the ticker card → lands on AAPL detail screen with a pre-filled buy order

user_journeys.name: Share a live ticker card in a message
steps: User is viewing a ticker detail screen (e.g. NVDA at $875)
User taps 'Share to Chat' → channel picker opens
User selects #nvda-bulls → a ticker card is attached to the message draft
User adds text ('My updated target after yesterday's run:') and sends
The message appears in the channel thread with a live price card that updates in real time

user_journeys.name: Send a message in a channel
steps: User opens a channel, types in the compose box
Message appears in the thread within 500ms; other channel members see it simultaneously

primary.metric: % of MAUs using Chat (sent or read at least once per week)
primary.measurement: Analytics event chat_opened or message_sent, deduplicated by user per 7-day window

secondary.metric: Message-to-trade conversion rate (user chats then trades within 10 min)
secondary.measurement: Analytics funnel event: ticker_card_tap → order_submitted within 10 min window

secondary.metric: Ticker card share actions per DAU
secondary.measurement: Analytics event share_to_chat with tickerRef set

secondary.metric: 30-day retention lift (Chat users vs non-Chat users)
secondary.measurement: Cohort comparison: login_event within 30 days of signup, Chat vs non-Chat cohort

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Message delivery end-to-end latency < 500ms at p95 under 5,000 concurrent users
All messages retained in cold storage for 7 years (MiFID II Article 16)

functional_requirements.requirement: Users can browse a list of public channels sorted by activity.
Users can join or leave a channel; joined channels appear in the sidebar.
Users can send text messages up to 2,000 characters in a channel.
Messages are delivered to all channel members within 500ms (p95).
Users can attach a live ticker card from any xCube instrument to a message.
Ticker cards display: symbol, current price, and intraday % change — updated every 15 seconds.
Tapping a ticker card opens the instrument detail screen.
All messages pass through content moderation before delivery.
Messages flagged by moderation are held pending human review and not delivered to channel members.
All messages are retained for 7 years (MiFID II compliance).
Users can create a new public channel with a name and topic description.
[Phase 1] Users receive push notifications (APNs on iOS, FCM on Android) for new messages in joined channels within 5 seconds of posting.
[Phase 1] Users can mute push notifications per channel; muted channels suppress all push delivery for that user.

out_of_scope: Live ticker card sharing and push notifications — Phase 1 (after MVP channel and messaging foundation is validated)
Message threading or reply chains — Phase 2
Message reactions or emoji responses — Phase 2
Content moderation automation — Phase 2 (Phase 1 uses human review queue for flagged content)
Voice or video channels — not planned
File or image attachments (non-ticker) — not planned
Private (invite-only) channels — not planned for MVP or Phase 1

open_questions.description: MiFID II Article 16 scope — does general channel discussion meet the 'related to a transaction' threshold requiring 7-year retention?
Should moderation hold messages before delivery (safe but adds latency) or deliver then post-remove (faster but risks exposure)?
WebSocket infrastructure cost scaling beyond 10,000 concurrent connections — at what user milestone do we need to re-architecture?
Should channel creation be open to all users (network effects) or gated to power users (quality control)?
Finance influencer partnerships — liability if influencer uses the channel to promote positions they hold
